description: Search quickstart, auth, sandbox, OpenAPI, and runtime skill docs on this consumer MCP connection. Topics are ranked by how many query words appear in their title, summary, URI, or category; each match carries its title, category, URI, MIME type, summary, and public href, and an empty matches list means no topic contains any query word. Pass a match's uri to docs_get_resource to read it.

limit.description: How many of the best-ranked topics to return. Omit it to get the top 5.

query.description: Search terms describing the documentation need.

name: docs_search

href.description: Public web URL for the same content.

mime_type.description: Format of the resource body, such as `text/markdown` or `text/yaml`.

uri.description: Resource URI to pass to docs_get_resource.

query.description: The search query after trimming whitespace.

total.description: Number of matches in this response after limit, not every topic that matched.

title: Coverage Cat docs search
